What is the gradient of the product f(x,y)g(x,y) if f(x,y)=xy2 and g(x,y)=e−(x2+y2)?

a
 e−(x2+y2)(y(1−2x2) i+x(1+2y2) j)
b
 e−(x2+y2)(y2(1−2x2) i+2xy(1−y2) j)
c
e−(x2+y2)(y2(1−x2) i+2xy(1−y2) j)
d
 e−(x2+y2)(x(1−y2) i+xy(1−x2) j)
e
 e−(x2+y2)(x2(1+y2) i+2y2(1+x2) j)
